# L4 metadata version 1 golden vectors of the UDP command, CmdUDP 0x11 (M6
# design A3.5). Hand-written, independent of the encoder; frozen at M6.
# After v2.0.0 a frozen vector changes only with a new wire minor version,
# an optional PREFACE feature bit, or a new version of a versioned payload
# format such as L4 metadata. In addition, when an extension field that the
# old decoder rejects deterministically takes a new value, such as an L4
# metadata command, a new vector file may define it: every existing vector
# file stays byte-identical and testdata/frozen.sha256 only gains lines.
# This is such a file: v2.0.0's ParseMetadata answers command 0x11
# BadCommand, and meta-v1.txt is unchanged.
#
#   "L4" | ver u8 (1) | cmd u8 (0x11) | atyp u8 | addr | port u16 | flen u16 | first | app
#
#   ok  <name> <hex> <Request.Addr> <Request.First as hex, or -> <Request.App as hex, or ->
#   bad <name> <hex or -> <code: BadRequest BadVersion BadCommand BadAddress>
#
# TestL4MetadataGolden_L44 decodes this file with ParseUDPMetadata and
# meta-v1.txt with ParseMetadata, and every ok vector of each file is
# BadCommand through the other parser. Every ok vector truncated by one
# byte inside its header is BadAddress, inside flen or first BadRequest.
